name: @angel/electron
description: angel AI — invisible real-time AI assistant desktop app

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync('bundle',{recursive:true,force:true});" && tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('dist/apps/electron/src','bundle',{recursive:true,dereference:true});" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('../../apps/server/dist','bundle/server',{recursive:true,dereference:true});" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('../../apps/web/out','bundle/web/out',{recursive:true,dereference:true});" && electron-builder --win
